meta_description: Fiesta Garden Services in Southampton. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local, reliable, competitive rates. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to immaculate lawns, we handle every aspect of garden care so you can enjoy your outdoor space.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance or a complete garden redesign, Fiesta Garden Services covers every aspect of professional horticulture.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting, hedge trimming, and border maintenance tailored to your schedule. We keep your garden looking pristine year-round.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatments
services.desc: Professional lawn mowing, scarification, aeration, and targeted weed and moss treatments to restore your turf's health and colour.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Trimming
services.desc: Safe, skilled pruning and hedge cutting using modern equipment. We keep boundaries tidy and trees healthy with expert seasonal care.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Rapid clearance of overgrown beds, undergrowth removal, and full garden tidy-ups. Ideal for neglected spaces or pre-sale preparation.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs, planting plans, and landscaping projects. We transform bare plots into beautiful, functional outdoor rooms.

services.title: Patio & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Installation and repair of patios, decking, pathways, and garden edging. Durable, attractive surfaces that enhance your garden's usability.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden is a reflection of home — we treat yours with the same care.
about_para_1: Fiesta Garden Services has been caring for Southampton gardens for over two decades. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, maintaining hundreds of residential and small commercial gardens across the New Forest fringes and wider Southampton area. We take pride in knowing our customers by name and understanding exactly what each garden needs.
about_para_2: We're repeat business specialists — most of our work comes from long-standing clients who trust us to keep their outdoor space looking its best. You won't find us rushing through jobs or cutting corners. Every hedge trim, every lawn treatment, and every landscaping project reflects our commitment to leaving you with a garden you genuinely enjoy.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Gardeners Say About Fiesta

reviews.text: Brilliant service. My garden was completely overrun with brambles and dead hedge. Fiesta came in and cleared the lot, shaped the remaining hedge beautifully, and left it spotless. Fair pricing too — no hidden costs. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Fiesta for lawn care every fortnight for nearly three years now. The lawn has never looked better. They're reliable, professional, and the lads are always friendly and respectful. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Had a complete garden redesign done last spring. They listened to what I wanted, came back with sensible ideas, and the execution was flawless. Still getting compliments from the neighbours. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David H.
